articles.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill nine
articles.description: Lebanon says a recent Israeli escalation is jeopardising a US-brokered ceasefire meant to end the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.

articles.title: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
articles.description: There was no announcement of a major breakthrough, after Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner travelled to Kyiv.

articles.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
articles.description: The comments came a day after Washington said it had struck Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran's attacks on US warships in the region.

articles.title: India's high-stakes exam system faces a crisis of trust
articles.description: As exam scandals persist, critics ask whether fixing the centralised testing agency is enough or if the model needs to change.

articles.title: FIFA confirms Infantino to stand for re-election as president
articles.description: FIFA has confirmed Gianni Infantino is standing for re-election next year after the president declined Sky News questions on his future in the job, now insisting "nothing has changed".

articles.title: Seven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon
articles.description: Seven people, including two women, have been killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, the Lebanese health ministry has said.
